title: Vision & Mission
content:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces"][vc_column][vc_single_image image="7975" img_size="full" alignment="center"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Vision"]

Development of academically excellent, culturally vibrant, socially responsible and globally competent human resources.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Mission"]
  • To keep pace with advancements in knowledge and make the students competitive and capable at the global level
  • To create an environment for the students to acquire the right physical, intellectual, emotional and moral foundations and shine as torchbearers of tomorrow’s society
  • To strive to attain ever-higher benchmarks of educational excellence
[/eikra-vc-text-title][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Core Values"]
  • Ethics
  • Integrity
  • Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Collaboration
  • Social Responsibility
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
